propositions: Pandoc subprocess invocations can hang indefinitely because pypandoc sets no timeout and subprocess.run(timeout=) reaps only the direct child, not process groups with spinning grandchildren

The renderer must use subprocess.Popen(start_new_session=True) with caller-side timeout via communicate() and reap via rebar._proc.reap_process_group on TimeoutExpired to kill the entire process group
Per-unit fallback to original Markdown on timeout or non-zero exit must preserve existing behavior and ensure one unit's failure never affects another
The pypandoc-binary wheel (pinned ==1.15, bundling pandoc 3.6.1) must have its GPL license entry recorded in a new repo-root NOTICE file and the pin verified in CI
Safe-run batching of contiguous units was measured to yield only 12% fewer spawns while changing rendered output on 12% of corpus bodies, making it a bad trade that is descoped from this story
